answer: Glacier-thaw escrow: a new identity's pay freezes in a glacier escrow that thaws 10% per epoch of attested useful work, each job copper-stamped to one funding wallet. Once per epoch a comet sweep re-audits one random identity; a fake forfeits its frozen balance plus a 12 POA bond. The bond doubles per extra identity from the same wallet, so the first fake risks 12 POA while the tenth risks 6,144 POA.
